records.reproductionTest: Deliberately omit tenant filter in an isolated repository/service call; not executed without disposable PostgreSQL.
records.currentBehavior: Raw shared Prisma client; tenant scope relies on each service filter and known guard inputs.
records.expectedBehavior: Persistence fails closed on missing/mismatched tenant; explicit reviewed unscoped escape only.
records.impact: Cross-tenant confidentiality, integrity, financial and privacy compromise.
records.recommendation: Scoped repository/client, tenant-composite constraints, and RLS for highest-risk tables.
records.acceptanceTest: Adversarial service/action/API/worker tests fail at persistence; migration and rollback evidence pass.

records.reproductionTest: Mock accepted/rejected/timeout/duplicate provider callbacks; current focused provider tests passed but POS authority integration is absent.
records.currentBehavior: Submitted references can produce PAID/PROCESSED locally; signed provider ingestion is separate.
records.expectedBehavior: Only verified provider evidence transitions non-cash payments/refunds to final states.
records.impact: Fraud, false settlement, reconciliation and close misstatement.
records.recommendation: Provisional-to-settled lifecycle with clearing/suspense and provider-authoritative refunds.
records.acceptanceTest: Rejected/timeout evidence never posts final funds; duplicate callbacks are idempotent; settlement reconciles.

records.reproductionTest: Shared status truth-table test is missing; selected projection suites passed independently.
records.currentBehavior: Three different payment-status inclusion rules answer the same cash/AR question.
records.expectedBehavior: One versioned metric contract with source, as-of, settlement, refund, and partial semantics.
records.impact: Misleading management decisions and close/report inconsistency.
records.recommendation: Canonical payment/metric adapter and shared fixtures for every projection.
records.acceptanceTest: All projections pass the same status/refund/as-of truth table.

records.reproductionTest: Create more than 300 representative records and compare totals; not present/executed.
records.currentBehavior: Totals are computed from capped arrays without partial-data indication.
records.expectedBehavior: Exact database aggregates plus paginated detail and explicit completeness metadata.
records.impact: Silent revenue, cash, AR, AP, expense, and trend understatement.
records.recommendation: Move totals to database aggregates; preserve caps only for detail lists.
records.acceptanceTest: Exact totals beyond every cap; partial list metadata visible.

records.reproductionTest: Real PostgreSQL concurrent sale/refund test required; not run.
records.currentBehavior: Read-compute-update by ID can overwrite concurrent balance changes.
records.expectedBehavior: Atomic increment or version/current-value CAS with reconciliation.
records.impact: Incorrect cash drawer and receivable balances.
records.recommendation: Atomic/CAS updates and ledger-derived reconciliation.
records.acceptanceTest: Concurrent operations yield balances equal to immutable transaction/ledger sums.

records.reproductionTest: Audit-sink outage during invite/privileged mutation requires isolated failure fixture; not run.
records.currentBehavior: Missing organization skips audit; database errors are swallowed; invite transaction uses global writer.
records.expectedBehavior: Mandatory evidence commits atomically or through transactional outbox with explicit fail policy.
records.impact: Repudiation and incomplete security/control evidence.
records.recommendation: Transactional audit obligations and monitored outbox lag.
records.acceptanceTest: Outage follows documented fail-closed/deferred behavior without losing evidence.

records.reproductionTest: Source-confirmed; concurrent redemption test not run.
records.currentBehavior: Bearer token stored, indexed, and queried directly.
records.expectedBehavior: Digest-only storage and one-use conditional redemption.
records.impact: Workspace takeover after database read/backup exposure.
records.recommendation: Hash token, CAS consume, migrate/cut over legacy tokens.
records.acceptanceTest: Raw token never persists; concurrent redemption has one winner; logs/errors redact token.

records.reproductionTest: No completed enrollment/challenge runtime available.
records.currentBehavior: MFA fields exist but enrollment/challenge is unfinished; assurance is password-level.
records.expectedBehavior: Completed TOTP/WebAuthn and MFA-level step-up for high-risk actions.
records.impact: Privileged account takeover and fraudulent approvals.
records.recommendation: Complete MFA lifecycle, secure secret storage, and action policy.
records.acceptanceTest: High-risk actions reject password-only assurance and accept valid fresh MFA.

records.reproductionTest: Mocked entitlement/protect suites passed, proving current observe behavior rather than production enforcement.
records.currentBehavior: Observe mode allows access; missing requested modules can imply legacy full suite.
records.expectedBehavior: Durable server-owned entitlements, default deny, consistent route/action/API/worker/read-model enforcement.
records.impact: Commercial bypass and access to unowned module data/actions.
records.recommendation: Provisioning lifecycle and enforcement reconciliation gate.
records.acceptanceTest: Absent/suspended/expired/dependency-missing entitlements deny every boundary consistently.

records.reproductionTest: Mocked offline suites passed; original-actor cross-user replay assertion is missing.
records.currentBehavior: Replay attributes canonical commit to current caller; per-event original actor is not immutable.
records.expectedBehavior: Original actor/device/session claims persist; replayer/service identity is separate; entitlement enforced.
records.impact: Segregation-of-duties and nonrepudiation failure.
records.recommendation: Persist original actor and require explicit replay authority/module.
records.acceptanceTest: Replay under another user preserves original actor and records replayer separately.

records.reproductionTest: Organization-switch cache test not present; selected query boundary tests passed.
records.currentBehavior: Global QueryClient; many keys omit trusted organization/session context.
records.expectedBehavior: Context-prefixed keys and/or guaranteed cache clear/remount on context change.
records.impact: Stale or cross-context data disclosure in client memory/UI.
records.recommendation: Canonical key factory, mutation/projection registry, context-change reset.
records.acceptanceTest: Switch organization without reload; previous context is absent and all new requests are correctly scoped.

records.moduleWorkflow: production logging, metrics, alerts and incidents
records.reproductionTest: No production sink, paging, retention, or recovery drill accessed.
records.currentBehavior: Default sink is no-op; static registry exists; delivery is unproven.
records.expectedBehavior: Required production sink, SLIs/SLOs, alert delivery, ownership, retention, and drills.
records.impact: Incidents and control failures may be invisible.
records.recommendation: Fail startup/release when required telemetry is absent; prove alert/recovery path.
records.acceptanceTest: Synthetic failure produces correlated log/metric/alert/page and documented recovery evidence.

records.moduleWorkflow: migration, secrets, statutory, provider and rollback evidence
records.reproductionTest: Unsafe in unidentified environment; intentionally not run.
records.currentBehavior: Local static readiness improved; production target/execution, secrets, expert and runtime evidence blocked.
records.expectedBehavior: Clean production-shaped rehearsal with immutable independent evidence.
records.impact: Unsafe deployment or false certification.
records.recommendation: Hold release; execute controlled rehearsal and independent review.
records.acceptanceTest: Migration/history, secrets, providers, observability, restore/rollback, sources and expert approval all pass in named environment.

records.reproductionTest: Source confirmed; authenticated browser flow not run.
records.currentBehavior: Demo/null/broken and duplicate destinations remain customer-visible or linked.
records.expectedBehavior: Every route has a job, owner, canonical status, permission, module, telemetry and safe redirect/retirement.
records.impact: Broken journeys, duplicated support/training, reduced trust.
records.recommendation: Canonical registry; restrict demo; retire null; fix user edit; consolidate aliases/funnels.
records.acceptanceTest: Zero broken links; aliases preserve access and redirect; demos excluded from production; one measured funnel.

records.reproductionTest: 31 focused access/approval tests passed; simultaneous approval test requires PostgreSQL.
records.currentBehavior: Maker-checker is enforced but state is read before transaction and update lacks status/version CAS.
records.expectedBehavior: Exactly one valid approval transition/evidence record.
records.impact: Duplicate or overwritten approval evidence.
records.recommendation: Transaction-local load plus status/version CAS.
records.acceptanceTest: Two simultaneous approvers produce one transition and one canonical event/audit record.

records.reproductionTest: Focused AP suite passed; concurrent duplicate creation not tested with DB.
records.currentBehavior: Find-then-create can race; no matching uniqueness invariant.
records.expectedBehavior: At most one active exception per deterministic identity.
records.impact: Duplicate queues, approvals and evidence.
records.recommendation: Deterministic fingerprint and partial/compound uniqueness with upsert/CAS.
records.acceptanceTest: Concurrent creates yield one active record and idempotent result.

records.reproductionTest: Route test exists; shared-cache/content-sniff runtime test not run.
records.currentBehavior: Whole file read, extension MIME, public caching.
records.expectedBehavior: Private/no-store tenant response, streamed content, verified type and safe limits.
records.impact: Shared-cache disclosure, content ambiguity, memory pressure.
records.recommendation: Private caching, magic-byte validation, streaming, quotas/malware policy.
records.acceptanceTest: No shared caching; spoofed extensions rejected; large files stream within limits.

records.moduleWorkflow: provider payload and tenant privacy lifecycle
records.reproductionTest: Static source review; broad retention/erasure runtime evidence absent.
records.currentBehavior: Masked reference coexists with retained raw provider object; no general lifecycle evidenced.
records.expectedBehavior: Minimized/encrypted payload, purpose-bound retention, legal-hold and erasure/export policy.
records.impact: Excess PII retention and breach scope.
records.recommendation: Privacy data map and lifecycle with immutable-record exceptions.
records.acceptanceTest: Every sensitive field has purpose, access, encryption, retention and deletion/legal-hold evidence.

records.reproductionTest: Quoted CSV/timestamp compatibility fixtures not evidenced.
records.currentBehavior: Simple comma split and implicit millisecond timestamp contract.
records.expectedBehavior: RFC-compliant parser and versioned provider timestamp/signature contract.
records.impact: Import corruption, false rejection/acceptance, provider incompatibility.
records.recommendation: Mature parser, explicit version/units, replay uniqueness fixtures.
records.acceptanceTest: Quoted/newline CSV and seconds/milliseconds contract fixtures pass; replay rejected.

records.moduleWorkflow: CSP, trusted proxy and rate limiting
evidence: client IP derived from forwarding headers
records.reproductionTest: No DAST/proxy-bypass test run.
records.currentBehavior: Defense depth depends on inline scripts and trusted forwarding behavior; process-local rate limits.
records.expectedBehavior: Nonce/hash CSP, explicit trusted proxy, distributed abuse controls and race-safe lockout.
records.impact: XSS defense-depth and brute-force/throttling bypass.
records.recommendation: Harden CSP/proxy configuration and distributed rate-limit/lockout.
records.acceptanceTest: Spoofed forwarded headers do not alter identity/rate bucket; CSP works without unsafe-inline.

records.reproductionTest: Workflow inventory; networked scanners not run.
records.currentBehavior: Strong domain gates; no explicit SAST/SCA/secret/SBOM/container/DAST jobs found.
records.expectedBehavior: Risk-proportionate automated security/supply-chain evidence.
records.impact: Vulnerability, secret and artifact risk may escape current domain gates.
records.recommendation: Add pinned SAST/SCA/secret/SBOM/container checks and scoped DAST.
records.acceptanceTest: CI produces immutable scan/SBOM evidence with reviewed exceptions and fail policy.

records.reproductionTest: Static gate executed and failed.
records.currentBehavior: Two raw rethrows need migration; four raw domain errors lack typed stable codes.
records.expectedBehavior: Canonical typed errors and safe boundary mapping.
records.impact: Inconsistent client behavior, diagnostics and safe messaging.
records.recommendation: Migrate six findings or add reviewed classifications.
records.acceptanceTest: Raw-error fail gate passes and focused error mapping tests pass.

records.reproductionTest: Three focused invocations passed assertions but forced worker exit.

records.expectedBehavior: Clean deterministic teardown.
records.impact: Flaky/hanging CI and hidden resource lifecycle issues.
records.recommendation: Run narrowed --detectOpenHandles diagnostics and fix timer/client teardown.
records.acceptanceTest: Selected suites exit cleanly without force-exit warning.

records.reproductionTest: No broad authenticated manual keyboard/screen-reader run executed.

records.acceptanceTest: EN/FR, keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow and mobile evidence passes for each journey.
